name: COOKED
title: Spell served hot
description: Winds up a spell, throws a firestorm, then celebrates the damage.

name: SHATTER
title: That was my shield
description: Braces, forms a jade shield, takes a hit, then stares at the broken piece.

name: GOTCHA
title: Caught you
description: Crouches, charges and headbutts a target, then points at the viewer.

name: ITHREW
title: I had a plan
description: Winds up a magic throw, drops it at his feet and facepalms.

name: GG
title: Good game, good vibes
description: Pulls up a GG sign, waves it proudly and gives a thumbs-up.

name: RAVE
title: Absolutely no chill
description: Pumps glowsticks, lifts knees, leaps and lands in a disco pose.

name: CLUTCH
title: Calculated. Obviously.
description: Panics, dives for a falling star, catches it and proudly shows it off.
